description_en: Lists the authorized or unauthorized hosts for a bastion host user group
description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机用户组已授权或未授权的主机列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-hosts-for-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostsForUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance that contains the user group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询授权主机列表的用户组所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the bastion host instance is located.

For more information about regions and their corresponding IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询授权主机列表的用户组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query for authorized or unauthorized hosts. Valid values:

Authorized (default)

Unauthorized
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机列表的模式。取值：
Authorized：已授权（默认）
Unauthorized：未授权
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group whose hosts you want to list.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to obtain the user group ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询授权主机列表的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.
We recommend that you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The address of the host. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address. Exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机地址，可使用域名或IP地址。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en: The name of the host. Exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机的操作系统类型。取值：
Linux
Windows
parameters.name: os_type

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The address type of the host. Valid values:

Public: a public IP address

Private: a private IP address
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
主机的地址类型。取值：
Public：公网地址
Private：私网地址

HostPrivateAddress.description_en: The private IP address of the host. This can be a domain name or an IP address
HostPrivateAddress.description_zh: 主机的私网地址，可为域名或IP地址

HostPublicAddress.description_en: The public IP address of the host. This can be a domain name or an IP address
HostPublicAddress.description_zh: 主机的公网地址，可为域名或IP地址

OSType.description_en:
The OS type of the host. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
OSType.description_zh:
主机的操作系统类型。取值：
Linux
Windows

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
